q1_issues.issue: The perfect infinitive 'to have taken' marks anteriority, but the reified take event inside the seal carries no status atom at all, so the claimed prior action is recorded as untensed.

q2_gaps: direct quotation as the complement of a speech verb ("...," Fleischer said) — the instruction set covers a finite that-clause complement but says nothing about quoted speech, its verbatim string, or whether quoted deixis is preserved

a collective evaluative predicate on a definite plural ('the steps are insufficient') — the instruction set forces a copular predicate on a definite plural through the distributive rule and carves out only size/name as genuine collection properties
notes: Nesting is right: nothing of the quoted proposition is asserted at top level, and only the definite referents (the steps, the Iranians, al-Qaeda) project out of the seal; 'claim to have taken' correctly takes the control-verb (non-sealing) pattern with the controller copied in, and 'InTermsOf' is licensed by the multi-word-preposition convention.
